text:
Sam Park: Heads up 1 staging build failing on URL-encoded anchors. linkcheck shows 404 for /guides/migration#upgrading-to-v2 -> path contains `%E2%80%8B` in generated fragment.
Evelyn Ruiz: `%E2%80%8B` is the UTF-8 encoding for a zero-width space. any chance a title had an invisible char in front?
Sam Park: yup, the frontmatter title in `docs/guides/migration.md` had a copied bullet that left a ZWSP at the start: `title: "Upgrading to v2"` (in the source you can't see it).
Carlos Mendez: rough. two possible fixes: strip invisible chars in a prebuild sanitiser, or clean the offending files and add a linter rule. i'd favor cleaning and linting.
Evelyn Ruiz: i'll scrub frontmatter in the affected files and run a repo-wide check: `git grep -nP "[\x{200B}-\x{200D}\x{FEFF}]" -- docs/` then open a PR.
Sam Park: also confirm if any existing permalinks changed. if the slug shifted we need to add entries to `redirects.yaml` so old links keep working.
Carlos Mendez: good point. after cleaning, run `yarn docs:build && ./bin/check-redirects` locally. I added a small script that compares old TOC anchors to new ones and emits a list of changed fragments.
docs-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck failed on branch fix/migration-zwsp 1 1 broken fragment(s) in docs/guides/migration.md: line 12
Evelyn Ruiz: pushed the cleanup commit removing the invisible chars and updated `redirects.yaml` with `- from: "/guides/migration#upgrading-to-v2"
  to: "/guides/migration#upgrading-to-redwood-v2"` (temporary).
Sam Park: thanks. can someone add a note in the changelog for docs consumers about redirects we added? low risk but good to document.
Carlos Mendez: i'll prepare a tiny entry and also add a lint rule in the docs-lint that fails on frontmatter containing control chars. PR #4332 created.
docs-bot: CI: docs/build-staging succeeded for PR #4332 1 all checks passed :white_check_mark:
Evelyn Ruiz: great. follow-ups: Carlos to land linter, Sam to monitor link logs post-deploy, Evelyn to scan other guides for stray invisible chars. will update this thread if anything pops up.
Sam Park: one more note 1 automated converters from swagger/openapi sometimes insert invisible chars into generated titles. if we use an import script, we should run sanitization there too.
Carlos Mendez: noted; i'll add sanitization in the importer and a unit test.
Evelyn Ruiz: thanks all. closing this thread once post-deploy link sweep is clean.
